question: Test signed cut balance as a robust half-transfer guard and discriminate aggregate from sector-resolved transfer.
assumptions: Real Euclidean source and direct ports with closed skew exchange and nonzero source-only initial stock.
Shared continuous positive rate for the half-transfer theorem. Separate sector rates for the counterexample.
Additive normalized balance error with amplitude and derivative bounds over a declared bracket.
target_exposure: Known 1/2 guard and 2:1 target from v0.7
fitted_choices: Witness rates chosen to distinguish aggregate from component balance; no fitted data
result: Common positive phase gives an exact transversal half split. Observation error epsilon bounds fraction error by epsilon/2 in a certified bracket. Unsynchronized sector rates give a transversal aggregate zero at fractions 1/4 and 3/4.
next_discriminant: Derive or test shared phase or sector-resolved cut latches in a native interaction, then source depletion separately.
